question_text: MEASUREMENT uses (DeviceID, SensorID, Timestamp) as a composite primary key. Outline why Timestamp may be needed when the same sensor measures the same device repeatedly.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: DeviceID and SensorID repeat for successive measurements. Timestamp distinguishes those events so separate readings can be stored without duplicate keys.

marking_points.criterion: Timestamp distinguishes repeated events for uniqueness.
